name: Gurren Lagann
description: When a young laborer escapes to the world aboveground, he discovers a violent land in which humans battle robots controlled by a power-hungry noble.

videos.title: I'll See What I Wanna See!!
videos.overview: An uncut version of episode six, involving Kamina's hopes of seeing Yoko and The Black Siblings naked, even at the risk of his friends' safety.

videos.title: My Gurren is Shiny!!
videos.overview: Special episode bundled with the Nintendo DS game based on the series. Envious of seeing how Simon keeps his Lagann clean and neat, Kamina asks the mysterious Chitori to clean up his Gurren for him, unaware of her true intentions.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-1: Rap is a Man's Soul! (Dai-Gurren-Dan Theme)
videos.overview: In a medieval Europe setting, Simon, Kamina and Viral infiltrate a castle where Nia is held captive by a Grand Zamboa-like enemy. Viral's wife and Yoko also make appearances.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-2: BafBaf! Do You Like Being That... Fired Up!!
videos.overview: Viral encounters a pachinko Gunmen, and then unleashes it on Kamina, Yoko and Simon.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-3: Boing vs. Boing
videos.overview: A version of the series in an artistically-stylized medieval Japan setting.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-4: Pierce the Heavens With Your XXX
videos.overview: In a steampunk  wild west theme, Viral is a horse  riding hero leading the oppressed beastmen against Kamina, riding Dai-Gurren as a roving bandit.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-5: Rap is a Man's Soul! (Kamina's Theme)
videos.overview: A nude Gimmy steals articles of clothing from Simon, Kamina and Yoko using kancho.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-6: To Hell With This Gattai!
videos.overview: In a modern-looking alternate setting, humans pilot Lagann and Gurren against Beastmen-like enemies in Gunmen and then team up with other humans against a Dai-Gunmen.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-7: Libera Me From Hell
videos.overview: An experimental real world look at the environment of the surface portrayed in the first half of the series, which includes the shadow of a man running and a skull motif, possibly in reference to Kamina's father.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 1-8: All You Bastards, Get Fired Up!
videos.overview: The story of Lordgenome's past, with the first war against the Anti-Spirals, Lordgenome's descent into madness and the rise of the Beastmen.

videos.title: Viral's Sweet Dream
videos.overview: Viral tries to get some sleep, but keeps on having terrifying nightmares.

videos.title: Tengen Toppa Gurren Lagann Movie: Festival Eve
Kirameki Youko Box: Pieces of Sweet Stars
videos.overview: A music video by character designer Nishigori Atsushi for "S.t.a.r.S," the new song that the voice actress Inoue Marina sings in her Youko persona. Nishigori personally planned and directed entirely new footage for the music video. The bundled DVD includes a video interview with Inoue and a booklet with over 130 pages of storyboards, original drawings, and designs.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-1: The Sense of Wonder
videos.overview: A love story about Simon and Nia.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-2: My XXX is the Best in the Universe
videos.overview: A video in the visual style of Nia's flashback.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-3: Dai-Gurren, Good Bye
videos.overview: Gimmy and Darry find a series of mysterious doors in the underbelly of the Dai-Gurren.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-4: Big Building
videos.overview: A strange, sentai-esque story starring Simon and Rossiu.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-5: Kiyal's Magical Time, Three Minutes Before
videos.overview: A magical girl style video focusing on Kiyal.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-6: Gunmen Symphony
videos.overview: A story about the development of Gunmen.

videos.title: Gurren Lagann Parallel Works 2-7: Kittan Zero
videos.overview: An adventure of the Black siblings set before they met Kamina and Simon.

videos.title: Bust Through the Heavens with Your Drill!!
videos.overview: Living underground in Giha Village, Simon and Kamina dream of a life on the surface. When their home is invaded from above, it is up to them to activate the mysterious mecha Lagann and save their village.

videos.title: I Said I'm Gonna Pilot That Thing!!
videos.overview: Now that they've made it to the surface, Simon and Kamina must join together with Yoko and her village to defeat the Beastmen pursuing them.

videos.title: Who Do You Think You Are, Having Two Faces!!
videos.overview: Kamina and Simon must work together to defeat a dangerous new Beastman threat.

videos.title: Having Lots of Faces Doesn't Make You Great!
videos.overview: Team Gurren must work together with the eccentric Black Syblings to take down a Beastman foe on empty stomachs.

videos.title: I Don't Get It, Not One Bit!
videos.overview: Team Gurren must find their way out of a strange underground village where Gunmen are worshipped as divine beings.

videos.title: Sit in the Hot Tub 'Til You're Sick!!
videos.overview: Continuing to the Gunmen rallying point, Team Gurren finds themselves on a strange hot springs getaway.

videos.title: You're Gonna Do It!!
videos.overview: Thymilph, one of the Four Divine Generals of the mysterious Spiral King, arrives to support Viral's Enki, with the massive mobile Gunmen fortress, the Dai-Ganzan. Kamina and Simon pilot the Gurren-Lagann against seemingly overwhelming odds.

videos.title: Later, Buddy
videos.overview: Having temporarily stalled Viral and Thymilph in the last skirmish, the Team Gurren and their newly arrived allies join forces as "Team Dai-Gurren" and launch a decisive strike against the regrouping Gunmen force.

videos.title: What, Exactly, Is a Human?
videos.overview: Team Dai-Gurren managed to take control of the enemy fortress, but is still mourning the death of one of their own, especially Simon. After falling off a cliff, he notices a Gunman throw a capsule into a deep valley. Simon inspects it and finds he is able to open it with the same drill key he uses to pilot Lagann, and inside is a young human girl named Nia, but their introduction is cut short when an enemy Gunman appears.

videos.title: Who Is This Bro?
videos.overview: Nia true identity is revealed, as she flaunts her authority to get rid of another one of the Four Divine Generals, Adiane. The members of the Great Gurren Brigade are now suspicious of Nia and her true intentions, but she is only concerned about the depressed Simon. Adiane later returns to finish them all off, with Lordgenome's blessing.

videos.title: Simon, Hands Off
videos.overview: Team Dai-Gurren falls into a trap set by the third member of the Four Divine Generals, Guame. The Team is taken captive and stored underground to await execution. While digging an escape path, Simon finally understands Kamina's last words to him and after having a discussion with Guame, Nia finds out the reason why she was thrown away.

videos.title: Yoko, Will You Do Me a Favor?
videos.overview: Team Dai-Gurren are now on their way to Beastmen's capital city, Teppelin but there's a vast ocean in their way. The only way for them to get across is for the Dai-Gurren to be modified, so while they wait everyone goes to chill out at the beach. Once preparations are complete, the Great Gurren Brigade begins their cruise, but there's an ambush waiting for them.

videos.title: Eat Up Everyone!
videos.overview: Trying to do her part in Team Dai-Gurren, Nia decides to become a cook, but just before the crew have a taste of her dishes, Cytomander, the fourth member of the Divine Generals, launches an aerial attack on the Dai-Gurren. Simon leads the counter-attack on the Gurren-Lagann, this time accompanied by Yoko, who replaces a sick Rossiu.

videos.title: Well Met, Everyone
videos.overview: At last, Team Dai-Gurren arrives at the outskirts of Teppelin, but before aiming to the city, they must face a combined full-scale attack of Cytomander and Guame's forces.

videos.title: I Will Head Towards Tomorrow
videos.overview: The last of the Divine Generals fall, and the city of Teppelin collapses, revealing a Gunman of gigantic proportions. Simon and Nia struggle to pass through it in order to confront her father, the Spiral King himself.

videos.title: Compilation Episode
videos.overview: A recap of the story's events from the previous episodes.

videos.title: You Don't Know Anything!
videos.overview: During the following seven years, a new civilization rises and prospers under Simon's leadership. However, these peaceful times come to end when the threat mentioned in Lordgenome's last words starts to reveal itself.

videos.title: Tell Me the Secrets of This World
videos.overview: After the Anti-Spirals' first attack and Nia's astonishing announcement, Simon looks desperately for her, while Rossiu finally completes his secret project.

videos.title: We Will Survive By Any Means Necessary
videos.overview: To soothe the public opinion, Rossiu overthrows Simon and puts him under arrest. But when the Anti-Spirals launch a large-scale attack on Kamina City, he is left with no option but to let Simon engage the enemy using the Gurren-Lagann, not before resorting to extremes to put him under his control.

videos.title: How Far Will God Test Us?
videos.overview: As Simon arrives in prison, he unexpectedly meets Viral, who comments on how far he has fallen. Meanwhile, the truth about Rossiu's emergency plan and the consequences for those left behind on Earth are revealed.

videos.title: You Are Someone Who Ought to Survive
videos.overview: One year earlier, Yoko starts working as a schoolteacher on an island until she learns of the situation at Teppelin and returns to break Simon free. Once again reunited, Simon and the members of Team Dai-Gurren launch themselves into space to protect the Arc-Gurren from the enemy forces, now accompanied by Viral as co-pilot of the Gurren-Lagann.

videos.title: This Is My Final Duty!
videos.overview: The Gurren-Lagann and the Arc-Gurren join together to form the massive Arc-Gurren-Lagann and stop the Human Annihilation System.

videos.title: Let's Go, This Is the Final Battle
videos.overview: The members of Team Dai-Gurren make their preparations for the imminent war against the Anti-Spirals, but Rossiu is missing. However, when Kinon tells Simon about what he really intends to do, both start to look desperately for him.

videos.title: I'll Never Forget This Minute, This Second
videos.overview: Guided by Simon and Nia's feelings for each other, Team Dai-Gurren break through dimensions in search for the Anti-Spirals' homeworld. But after falling into the enemy's trap, they end up losing some of their most precious members, due to its vicious offensive.

videos.title: I Accept Your Last Wish!
videos.overview: Team Dai-Gurren struggles to escape from the ocean of despair created by the Anti-Spirals without success, until history repeats itself, as another irreplaceable member of the Team sacrifices himself to save the others.

videos.title: Let's Go, Buddy
videos.overview: After finally transforming their flagship into the Super Galactic Gurren-Lagann, Simon and his friends successfully fight back against the enemy. When their enemy starts to use their own memories and desires against them, Kamina reappears to help.

videos.title: The Lights in the Sky Are Stars
videos.overview: At last, Simon and Nia are reunited, and by combining the power of its members, Team Dai-Gurren creates the galaxy-sized Tengen Toppa Gurren-Lagann, and engage the Anti-Spiral threat in a decisive battle to determine the fate of the universe.

language: Japanese, French, German, English, Korean, Spanish, Italian
